verify.subject: Confirm your email for Freero
verify.title: Welcome to Freero, {name}
verify.body: Confirm that this is your email address so you can invite people and share boards.
verify.outro: The link works once and expires in 48 hours. If you did not create a Freero account, ignore this message.
reset.subject: Reset your Freero password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.body: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password of the Freero account for {email}.
reset.outro: The link works once and expires in 30 minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password stays the same.
changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new Freero email address
changeEmail.title: Confirm your new email address
changeEmail.body: {name} asked to use this address for their Freero account.
changeEmail.outro: The link works once and expires in 24 hours. If this was not you, ignore this message.
changing.subject: Your Freero email address is being changed
changing.title: Email change requested
changing.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your account keeps using {current} until that link is opened.
changing.notYou: If this was not you, change your password now: it also signs out every other device.
